candidate_sentences.text: Despite the lower top-line revenue, the company achieved a gross profit of SEK 29,919,750, down from SEK 42,179,123 in 2024, while the gross margin improved to 62 percent from 57 percent.
Total equity stood at SEK 109,778,755, down slightly from SEK 110,540,939, resulting in an equity ratio of 71.8 percent compared to 80.8 percent in 2024.

Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period stood at SEK 8,748,046, up from SEK 2,231,929 at the start of the year.
